data.summary: Lead Business Analyst / Product Owner with 12+ years of experience delivering enterprise- scale digital transformation, procurement, vendor management, and compliance solutions. Proven expertise in Third Party Management processes including supplier onboarding, risk assessment, due diligence, performance monitoring, compliance validation, and lifecycle management. Strong experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, solution design, stakeholder management, UAT, system demonstrations, and cross-functional project leadership.

raw_sections.skills:
Core Skills • Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) • Supplier/Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence • Risk Assessment & Compliance Management • Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering • Process Mapping (As-Is / To-Be) • Solution Design • Stakeholder Management • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) • System Demonstrations & End User Training • Agile / Scrum •
Jira, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, SQL, Excel
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Product Owner | Persistent Systems Ltd. | Oct 2025 – Present • Defined product strategy and roadmap aligned with stakeholder goals. • Led requirements workshops, process analysis, and backlog prioritization. • Collaborated with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions. • Conducted stakeholder demonstrations and supported UAT activities.
IT Business Analyst / Product Owner | Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Nov 2016 – Oct 2025 • Led Third Party Management and Vendor Governance initiatives supporting supplier
onboarding and compliance validation.
Partnered with procurement, compliance, legal, and business stakeholders to gather
requirements and design solutions.
Conducted risk assessment and process mapping workshops for supplier lifecycle
management.
Managed UAT planning, execution, defect tracking, and business sign-off. • Delivered system demonstrations and end-user training sessions. • Monitored supplier performance metrics and supported regulatory compliance initiatives.
Senior Process Analyst | Interglobe Technologies, Gurgaon Feb 2014 – Nov 2016
Worked closely with crew planning, flight operations, and safety stakeholders to
enhance Crew Management Systems (CMS), ensuring system workflows aligned with DGCA, FAA, and EASA regulatory frameworks governing crew duty limits, rest periods, and operational safety.
Led requirement elicitation and stakeholder workshops to translate aviation regulatory
requirements and operational constraints into functional system requirements supporting crew scheduling, rostering, flight readiness, and compliance monitoring. • Developed UML diagrams, end‑to‑end process flows, and control models to represent
regulation‑driven aviation workflows, enabling development and QA teams to implement solutions compliant with DGCA / FAA / EASA operational and safety standards.
Defined and validated business, operational, and compliance‑focused test scenarios, actively participating in UAT cycles to ensure CMS functionality met regulatory adherence, safety expectations, and operational acceptance criteria.
raw_sections.education: Education Bachelor of Science – Electronics and Communications Engineering, Jagannath University, Jaipur
